title: Import from Odoo
description: Pull catalog, stock, stock operations, and users from the saved Odoo connection. Re-running updates the same records.

help.title: About Odoo import
help.overview: The Odoo import copies catalog, stock, and user data from Odoo into this company, using the saved Odoo connection. You choose which datasets to bring in, and can do a dry run first.

sections.title: Datasets
sections.body: Each record is matched to its Odoo id, so running the import again updates what it created instead of duplicating it.
items: Currencies: active Odoo currencies, matched by ISO code (EUR, USD, …). A currency that already exists here is reused as it is; a missing one is created.

Products: product templates with their variants and attribute values. Archived Odoo products arrive archived; archived variants arrive inactive. Each product gets its Odoo currency, which is matched or created even when Currencies is not selected.
Inventory: on-hand quantities per product and warehouse from Odoo's internal stock; existing rows are set to the Odoo quantity.
Stock changes: completed Odoo stock moves, written as stock movements with a matching reason.
Actions: completed internal transfers, written as done stock transfers.
Users: internal Odoo users, invited into the company with the sign-up role. They cannot sign in until they accept the invitation.

sections.title: Dry run and results
items: A dry run signs in to Odoo and only counts what each dataset would read; nothing is written.
A real run reports created, updated, and skipped counts per dataset. Rows that cannot be matched (for example a stock move for a product that was not imported) are skipped.
Import products before inventory and stock changes, and warehouses before inventory, so the references can be found.

sections.title: Permissions
items: You need permission to create each kind of record you import, plus the Odoo link records that remember the matches.
At least one dataset must be selected.

durationWarning: A large catalog can take several minutes. Keep this page open until the import finishes.
stockOverwriteWarning: Re-running replaces warehouse on-hand quantity with Odoo's quantity. Sales recorded here since the last import are overwritten.
missingConnection: Save the Odoo server for this company before importing.
dryRunDescription: Authenticate and count records without writing.
loadError: Could not load the Odoo connection
